body.x: Pup introduced a fast and accurate pocket scanner at 'CES 2018 Unveiled' held in Las Vegas on January 7th (Sunday).

Pup's next-generation scanner is ergonomically designed and easy to operate. It has one single button and anyone can use with one click per page. PUP has such convenience and accuracy. It has anti-halo and sharpness control and with smart LED lighting, composed of perfect frames, it can quickly recognize the object’s information. Scan easily any document formats up to A3 (poster) to A8 (business card), and it has automatic transfer and sharing features toward your Cloud and social media.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). A global news network, AVING news has reported the most issues about CES, MWC and IFA, the world's top three tech exhibitions for last 11 years. We will dispatch a special coverage team to CES this year to report top issues in the world market and introduce top companies in Korea to the world.
